{c_label}Cooldown:{/c_label} {c_resource}{Cooldown Time}{/c_resource} seconds
Explode into rage, Knocking Back surrounding enemies while gaining {c_number}[{SF_50}*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage, {c_important}{u}Berserking{/u}{/c}, and {c_important}{u}Unstoppable{/u}{/c} for {c_number}[{SF_13}|1|]{/c} seconds.
While {c_important}Wrath of the Berserker{/c} is active, every {c_number}{SF_36}{/c} Fury spent increases its duration by {c_number}{SF_37}{/c} second, up to {c_number}{SF_38}{/c}.
While {c_important}Wrath of the Berserker{/c} is active, all attacks causes a fiery explosion for {c_number}{payload:VARIANTB_IMPACT}{/c} damage.

While {c_important}Wrath of the Berserker{/c} is active, you gain a Fire aura that deals {c_number}{payload:UPGRADE_C_PAYLOAD}{/c} damage and Burns for {c_number}{dot:VARIANT_C_BURNING}{/c} damage over {c_number}{buffduration:VARIANT_C_BURNING}{/c} seconds. You gain {c_number}[SF_39 * 100|%|]{/c} All Resistance.
While {c_important}Wrath of the Berserker{/c} is active, gain {c_number}[SF_31 * 100|%+|]{/c} Attack Speed and increase {c_important}Fury{/c} Generation by {c_number}[SF_32 * 100|%x|]{/c}.
While {c_important}Wrath of the Berserker{/c} is active, your {c_important}{u}Berserking's{/u}{/c} base damage bonus is doubled.
The duration of {c_important}Wrath of the Berserker{/c} is increased to {c_number}[{SF_43}|1|]{/c} seconds.
{c_important}Wrath of the Berserker{/c} grants {c_number}{SF_48}{/c} stack of {c_important}{u}Overpower{/u}{/c} per second.
